title: The Wild Ones
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The last unmapped river in the Amazon basin is the Urupi, and the mapmakers have failed to reach its source three times. Explorer Dr. Lena Okafor gets a fourth expedition — with a crew of the failed: a disgraced cartographer, a sick botanist, a guide who has sworn off the river. The Urupi is not unmapped because it is hard. It is unmapped because it is guarded.
